svg.text: Actual NIFTY index candles | Times IST, start labels | A frozen, B author-corrected, C gap-candle candidate | Ledger overlays only
5-minute: full previous session + full current session
1-minute: first hour; only first five rows form the ORB candle
Opening O 24163.05 H 24166.95 L 24103.00 C 24118.70; body 69.35% | Manual direction / level / entry price UNKNOWN.
Gold band: first 5m. Purple: PDH/PDL. Orange: assumed inner levels. Dashed teal/magenta: assumed LONG/SHORT trendlines. Circles: ledger fills. Crosses: ledger leg exits.
Ledger exits are model fills; on target gaps the existing model keeps the target level, which can lie outside that minute bar.
LONG Method 1: previous_level_close, trend, quality; signed close distance -150.80
LONG Method 2: inner_close, trend, trendline, quality; signed close distance -112.05
LONG Gap/200DMA: gap_crossing, ma_close, quality; signed close distance -145.14
SHORT Method 1: quality; signed close distance 36.20
SHORT Method 2: trendline, quality; signed close distance 47.10
SHORT Gap/200DMA: gap_direction, gap_crossing, quality; signed close distance 145.14
